tldr: 美國6月CPI創六年來最大單月降幅，7月升息機率驟降，新任Fed主席華許重申對高通膨「零容忍」。
台股盤中一度重挫1,726點、終場跌642點，外資連8日賣超，市場聚焦台積電法說會。
IBM因獲利預警暴跌25%創史上最慘單日，摩根大通靠交易業務單季大賺169億美元創紀錄。
美國恢復對伊朗海上封鎖、荷姆茲海峽情勢升溫，油價創近一個月新高。
金管會強化利變保單資訊揭露並示警前沿AI攻擊風險；綜所稅首批退稅7月31日入帳。

items.title_zh: 外資賣超519億元連8賣 台股盤中殺逾1700點終場跌642點
items.title_en: Foreign investors dump NT$51.9 billion in eighth straight selling day as TAIEX sinks 642 points
items.summary_zh: 美伊衝突再度升溫衝擊台股，加權指數14日盤中一度重挫1,726點，最低觸及44,737點附近，終場跌幅收斂至642.57點、收44,737.95點，成交量達1.18兆元，留下長約1,083點的下影線，顯示低檔承接買盤強勁。外資持續提款賣超518.92億元、連續8個交易日賣超，期間累計賣超約4,000億元，主動式ETF「00403A主動統一升級50」遭大砍逾26萬張。市場關注國家隊守季線的力道能否化解地緣政治賣壓，後續觀察台指期結算與台積電法說會能否帶動量能回穩。
items.summary_en: Renewed US-Iran conflict slammed Taiwan's stock market on Monday, sending the TAIEX down as much as 1,726 points intraday before dip-buying narrowed the loss to 642.57 points at 44,737.95, on heavy turnover of NT$1.18 trillion. The index left a long lower shadow of about 1,083 points, showing strong support buying at the lows. Foreign institutional investors net sold NT$51.89 billion, their eighth consecutive session of selling, and cumulative foreign selling over the streak has reached roughly NT$400 billion. Active ETFs were also targeted, with more than 260,000 units of the 00403A active fund dumped. The selloff matters because it tests whether domestic buying, including government-linked funds defending the quarterly moving average, can absorb geopolitical shock ahead of Taiwan index futures settlement and TSMC's earnings call.

items.title_zh: 台積電法說倒數 大摩推演三劇本 樂觀情境股價強漲5%
items.title_en: Morgan Stanley maps three scenarios for TSMC's earnings call, sees up to 5% upside
items.summary_zh: 摩根士丹利認為台積電法說會前是布局時機，提出三種情境：基本情境（機率60%）為第三季美元營收季增10~15%、全年營收成長近40%、毛利率67~68%、資本支出560億美元，股價約有3%上漲空間；樂觀情境（機率20%）為營收季增15%、毛利率70%、資本支出600億美元，股價可望強漲5%；悲觀情境（機率20%）若展望不如預期，慎防股價下跌3~5%。分析師詹家鴻指出，台積電以2027年EPS計算本益比僅17倍，2025~2028年營收年複合成長率達32%，買方預期第三季毛利率69~70%。後續觀察艾斯摩爾財報、EUV出貨與雲端業者資本支出動向。
items.summary_en: Morgan Stanley says the run-up to TSMC's investor conference is a window to add positions, laying out three scenarios. The base case (60% probability) sees third-quarter US-dollar revenue up 10–15% quarter-on-quarter, full-year revenue growth near 40%, gross margin of 67–68% and capex of US$56 billion, implying roughly 3% share upside. The bull case (20%) assumes 15% sequential revenue growth, 70% gross margin and US$60 billion capex, with shares potentially rallying 5%; the bear case (20%) risks a 3–5% decline if guidance disappoints. Analyst Charlie Chan notes TSMC trades at only 17 times estimated 2027 earnings, with a projected 32% revenue CAGR for 2025–2028, while buy-side investors expect third-quarter gross margin of 69–70%. ASML's results, EUV shipment data and cloud providers' capex plans are the next catalysts.

items.title_zh: 國巨再爆違約交割2651萬元 兩週三起累計金額破億
items.title_en: Yageo hit by third default settlement in two weeks, totaling over NT$106 million
items.summary_zh: 證交所14日公告，國巨再度發生鉅額違約交割，由凱基證券林口分公司通報違約金額2,651.4萬元，這是國巨股票短短兩週內第三起違約交割，累計金額已逾1.06億元。連續違約交割顯示部分高槓桿投資人在股價劇烈波動中周轉不靈，遭券商申報違約。市場關注後續是否引發交易所加強監視、券商緊縮信用交易條件，以及違約股票處分帶來的額外賣壓；此事件也提醒投資人，以融資槓桿操作高價股在震盪行情中風險極高，須嚴控部位與資金調度。
items.summary_en: The Taiwan Stock Exchange announced that Yageo shares were involved in another large settlement default, with KGI Securities' Linkou branch reporting a failed settlement of NT$26.514 million. It is the third default involving the passive-component maker's stock in just two weeks, bringing the cumulative defaulted amount to more than NT$106 million. Settlement defaults of this size are unusual and typically signal that highly leveraged retail or margin traders were caught by the stock's sharp price swings, forcing brokers to report unpaid positions. The episode matters because repeated defaults can trigger closer exchange surveillance, tighter margin requirements from brokers and additional selling pressure as defaulted shares are disposed of, and it serves as a caution to investors trading volatile high-priced stocks with borrowed money.

items.title_zh: 上櫃公司6月營收狂飆38% 上半年成長25% 惟三產業衰退
items.title_en: OTC-listed companies' June revenue jumps 38%, first-half sales up 25%
items.summary_zh: 櫃買中心14日公布，全體上櫃公司6月單月營收合計3,519億元，較去年同期大增962億元、成長38%；累計上半年營收達1兆8,537億元，年增25%，僅三個產業別呈現衰退。上櫃公司營收全面成長，反映AI帶動的電子業景氣循環由大型權值股外溢至中小型供應鏈、關鍵零組件與利基設備廠。由於上櫃公司內需與散戶參與度較高，營收動能持續走強有助支撐中小型股獲利上修與評價，在大盤受地緣政治與外資賣壓震盪之際，成為市場資金選股的重要依據，後續觀察7月營收能否延續高成長。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's over-the-counter market delivered strong results, with the Taipei Exchange reporting combined June revenue of NT$351.9 billion for all OTC-listed companies, up NT$96.2 billion or 38% from the same month last year. Cumulative first-half revenue reached NT$1.8537 trillion, up 25% year-on-year, though three industries still posted declines. The broad-based growth reflects the AI-driven electronics upcycle spilling over from large-cap TWSE names into smaller suppliers, key-component makers and niche equipment vendors that dominate the OTC board. Strong top-line momentum matters for investors because OTC companies are more domestically focused and retail-heavy, so sustained revenue growth underpins earnings revisions and valuation support for mid- and small-cap portfolios, even as the broader market wrestles with geopolitical volatility and foreign selling pressure.

items.title_zh: 聯電新加坡廠量產矽光子晶片 鎖定AI與高速光通訊市場
items.title_en: UMC begins volume production of silicon photonics chips in Singapore, targeting AI and optical communications
items.summary_zh: 聯電已在新加坡12吋晶圓廠開始量產矽光子晶片，目標鎖定AI基礎建設與高速光通訊市場。此案與2021年成立的中國矽光子設計公司Silith Technology合作，歷時18個月完成從技術開發到量產的全程。Silith客戶包括光收發模組大廠Innolight與Coherent，兩者皆為輝達與Google的重要供應商，顯示聯電矽光子平台有機會切入AI供應鏈。矽光子以光訊號取代電訊號傳輸資料，可提升傳輸速度並降低功耗，是AI伺服器與資料中心的關鍵技術。聯電表示新加坡具備成熟12吋製造與研發能量，得以加速合作量產，為成熟製程之外開闢高成長利基，後續觀察訂單放量與良率表現。
items.summary_en: United Microelectronics Corp has started mass production of silicon photonics chips at its 12-inch fab in Singapore, aiming at AI infrastructure and high-speed optical communication markets. The milestone caps an 18-month collaboration with Silith Technology, a Chinese silicon-photonics design house founded in 2021, covering the full journey from technology development to volume manufacturing. Silith's customers include optical transceiver leaders Innolight and Coherent, both key suppliers to Nvidia and Google, giving UMC's platform a credible path into the AI supply chain. Silicon photonics transmits data with light instead of electrical signals, boosting bandwidth while cutting power consumption — a critical need for AI servers and data centers. UMC senior management said Singapore's mature 12-inch manufacturing and R&D base helped accelerate the partnership, positioning the foundry in a fast-growing niche beyond mature-node logic.

items.title_zh: 力積電8層WoW良率突破92% 通過國際先進封裝客戶驗證
items.title_en: Powerchip's 8-layer wafer-on-wafer yield tops 92%, wins advanced-packaging customer validation
items.summary_zh: 力積電董事長黃崇仁14日於法說會表示，公司投入Wafer-on-Wafer（WoW）晶圓堆疊技術已超過六年，目前8層WoW產品良率突破92%，並完成國際先進封裝客戶驗證，是全球少數具備多層WoW量產能力的業者。WoW將整片晶圓垂直鍵合，可縮短連線距離、提高頻寬與密度，在AI晶片逼近傳統微縮極限、3D整合需求大增之際更顯重要。8層堆疊良率跨過92%門檻，攸關技術能否具成本競爭力，通過客戶驗證則為量產訂單鋪路，讓力積電在先進封裝競賽中卡位，後續觀察實際訂單挹注與營運貢獻時點。
items.summary_en: Powerchip Semiconductor Manufacturing Corp chairman Frank Huang said the company's eight-layer Wafer-on-Wafer (WoW) products have achieved yields above 92% and passed validation by an international advanced-packaging customer. Powerchip has invested in WoW stacking technology for more than six years and is now one of the few manufacturers globally capable of multi-layer WoW volume production. WoW stacking bonds full wafers vertically to shorten interconnects, raising bandwidth and density — an approach increasingly relevant as AI chips run into the limits of conventional scaling and demand for high-bandwidth memory and 3D integration soars. Crossing the 92% yield threshold on eight layers matters commercially because yield determines whether the technology can be priced competitively; customer validation opens the door to production orders and positions the Taiwanese foundry in the advanced-packaging race alongside far larger rivals.

items.title_zh: 台塑集團調薪4.5%超出工會訴求 員工月均加薪2,700元再加碼津貼
items.title_en: Formosa Plastics Group grants 4.5% pay raise, exceeding union demands
items.summary_zh: 台塑集團14日與工會完成年度調薪協商，由總裁吳嘉昭親自定案，宣布2026年度集團企業薪資調幅達4.5%，超越台塑企業工會原先提出的3.66%訴求，員工平均每月加薪約2,700元，並加碼多項津貼，這是吳嘉昭2025年8月上任總裁以來首度調薪決策。台塑集團是台灣民營製造業最大雇主之一，向來是傳產薪資風向球，調幅高於工會訴求除有助帶動傳統產業薪資協商氛圍與內需消費，也顯示管理層對集團營運復甦的信心，後續觀察石化景氣回溫進度與其他大型集團是否跟進調薪。
items.summary_en: Formosa Plastics Group concluded its annual wage negotiation with the union, with group president Wu Chia-chao personally approving a 4.5% salary increase for 2026 — higher than the 3.66% rise the Formosa Plastics union had originally demanded. The raise works out to an average of about NT$2,700 more per month per employee, supplemented by several additional allowances. It is Wu's first wage decision since taking over as group president in August 2025. The generous settlement matters beyond the petrochemical conglomerate: Formosa is one of Taiwan's largest private-sector employers and a traditional bellwether for manufacturing pay, so an above-demand raise can set the tone for wage negotiations across traditional industries, support domestic consumption, and signal management confidence in the group's recovery despite a challenging petrochemical cycle.

items.title_zh: 30年長征迎收成 台灣生技業的黃金年代來了
items.title_en: Taiwan biotech enters its golden harvest year after a 30-year march
items.summary_zh: 台灣生技產業歷經30年投入終於進入收成期，多家公司陸續獲利，象徵從「研發世代」轉向「商業化世代」。指標股藥華醫藥股價突破千元、最高達1,570元，上半年營收119.8億元創歷史新高，新藥Ropeg已獲美國、加拿大上市許可，8月可望再取得第二項適應症。後續梯隊包括：基亞溶瘤病毒新藥獲日本上市許可、漢達多靶點癌藥預計7月底取得美國藥證、逸達前列腺癌新藥8月在美上市、泰合新劑型藥物第四季拚歐盟許可、仁新眼疾新藥年底前後可望獲美國核准。政策面「再生醫療雙法」上路，加上489億元健康台灣深耕計畫與360億元藥品韌性計畫，政府從補助研發轉向扶植產業，未來十年是關鍵收割期。
items.summary_en: After three decades of investment, Taiwan's biotech industry is shifting from an R&D era to a commercialization era, with a wave of companies turning profitable. PharmaEssentia's shares broke above NT$1,000 — peaking at NT$1,570 — as first-half revenue hit a record NT$11.98 billion; its drug Ropeg holds US and Canadian approvals with a second indication expected in August. The pipeline behind it is thick: OBI/Medigen's oncolytic-virus drug won Japanese approval, Handa Pharma expects a US license for its multi-target cancer drug in late July, Foresee's prostate-cancer drug launches in the US in August, TSH Biopharm expects EU approval in Q4, and Lin BioScience's eye drug could win US approval around year-end. Policy support — the regenerative medicine双法, a NT$48.9 billion Healthy Taiwan program and NT$36 billion drug-resilience plan — marks a shift from subsidizing R&D to nurturing an industry.

items.title_zh: 公股4金2銀上半年大賺885億元年增27.7%創新高 兆豐金稱冠
items.title_en: State-run financial holdings post record NT$88.6 billion first-half profit, up 27.7%
items.summary_zh: 公股四金控、二銀行6月自結盈餘14日全數出爐，合計上半年累計獲利達885.95億元、年增27.7%，創歷史新高。兆豐金以213.07億元穩居獲利王，是唯一突破200億元大關的公股金控；華南金以173.64億元改寫同期歷史新高。公股金融機構獲利創高，反映利差擴大、手續費收入強勁與換匯收益挹注。公股行庫是台灣信用體系與存股族配置的核心，獲利創紀錄有助強化資本、挹注國庫，也讓「國家隊」在股市震盪之際更有銀彈護盤，後續觀察下半年利率環境與股利政策走向。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's four state-run financial holding companies and two state-run banks all reported June self-settled earnings, with combined first-half profit reaching a record NT$88.595 billion, up 27.7% year-on-year. Mega Financial Holding remained the profit king at NT$21.307 billion, the only state-linked holding company to clear the NT$20 billion mark, while Hua Nan Financial posted a record NT$17.364 billion for the half. The strong showing reflects wider interest spreads, robust fee income and swap gains across the government-linked banking complex. It matters because state-run lenders anchor Taiwan's credit system and dividend-focused portfolios: record profits strengthen their capital positions, support treasury contributions to the government, and give the "national team" more firepower at a time when state-linked funds are being counted on to stabilize a volatile stock market.

items.title_zh: 中信金上半年賺395億元再創史上新高 EPS達1.96元
items.title_en: CTBC Financial's first-half profit hits record NT$39.5 billion with EPS of NT$1.96
items.summary_zh: 中信金14日公告6月自結獲利，單月稅後純益47.47億元，累計前6月合併稅後純益395.37億元，再度刷新上半年獲利紀錄，每股稅後純益1.96元。中信金旗下銀行受惠放款成長、財富管理手續費動能與海外獲利，保險子公司投資收益亦改善。中信金為民營金控指標，獲利連續創高代表利差、手收與資產品質等基本面穩健，並支撐股利發放能力與評價。市場後續觀察下半年金融市場震盪對交易部位與壽險投資組合的影響，以及財管業務在高資產客群布局下的成長力道。
items.summary_en: CTBC Financial Holding reported June self-settled results, with a single-month net profit of NT$4.747 billion and cumulative first-half consolidated net profit of NT$39.537 billion — a fresh record for the period — translating to earnings per share of NT$1.96. The private-sector heavyweight's banking arm continues to benefit from loan growth, wealth-management fee momentum and overseas earnings, while its insurance unit gains from improved investment income. The record matters for the sector because CTBC is a bellwether for Taiwan's privately run financial holding companies: sustained profit records support dividend capacity and share valuations, and they signal that despite market volatility, banking fundamentals — spreads, fee income and asset quality — remain solid. Investors will watch second-half results for the impact of market swings on trading and insurance investment portfolios.

items.title_zh: 金管會提醒金融業強化前沿AI模型攻擊風險整備 高層須主導
items.title_en: FSC tells financial industry to prepare for frontier-AI model attack risks
items.summary_zh: 金管會14日發布新聞稿提醒金融業，2026年4月問世的前沿AI模型已能協助找出漏洞、推演利用路徑並規模化產出可運作的攻擊方式，使漏洞被發現與武器化的速度同步上升，金融機構面臨短時間大量修補的壓力。金管會要求業者依循「金融資安韌性發展藍圖」優先落實七大措施：零信任架構、強化持續監控、資安左移、供應鏈管理（導入SBOM）、聯防協作情資共享、短期應急演練整備，以及防禦性AI規劃。金管會強調此風險已超越技術防護層面，是治理、營運與韌性的綜合課題，須由高階管理層主導整備，後續觀察各金融機構落實情形與監理檢查重點。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's Financial Supervisory Commission issued a reminder urging financial institutions to strengthen readiness against attacks powered by frontier AI models. The FSC noted that a frontier model released in April 2026 can help find vulnerabilities, map exploitation paths and generate working exploits at scale, meaning flaws can be discovered and weaponized far faster — pressuring institutions to patch large volumes of systems in short windows. The regulator asked firms to follow the financial cybersecurity resilience blueprint and prioritize seven measures: zero-trust architecture, enhanced continuous monitoring, shifting security left into development and testing, supply-chain management with SBOM, joint-defense intelligence sharing, short-term emergency drills, and planning for defensive AI. Crucially, the FSC framed the risk as beyond technical protection — a combined governance, operations and resilience issue that senior management must lead.

items.title_zh: 2026首案金融科技創新實驗落地 股票禮品卡帶動近5萬戶開戶
items.title_en: "Stock gift card" sandbox lands as 2026's first fintech experiment, adding 50,000 new brokerage accounts
items.summary_zh: 金管會14日宣布永豐金證券「股票禮品卡」金融科技創新實驗順利落地，為2026年首件核准的創新實驗案。實驗自2025年4月至2026年4月，民眾可購買禮品卡自用、贈人或作企業行銷，兌換後可作為股票交易資金。成果亮眼：累積兌換金額近6,000萬元、逾9萬人參與、帶動新增近5萬戶證券開戶。透過便利商店等日常消費場景銷售，成功吸引年輕族群參與投資，落實普惠金融。金管會已完成法規調適並正式開放辦理，並鼓勵其他業者申請創新實驗，顯示監理沙盒機制可將試辦轉化為常態業務，後續觀察其他券商跟進與相關商品發展。
items.summary_en: The FSC announced the successful completion of SinoPac Securities' "stock gift card" fintech sandbox experiment, the first innovation-experiment case to land in 2026. Running from April 2025 to April 2026, the program let consumers buy cards for themselves, as gifts or for corporate marketing, redeemable as funds for stock trading. Results were striking: nearly NT$60 million redeemed, more than 90,000 participants, and close to 50,000 new brokerage accounts opened. By distributing securities services through convenience stores and everyday consumption channels, the experiment drew younger investors into the market and advanced financial inclusion. The FSC has completed the necessary regulatory adjustments and formally opened the business, encouraging other firms to apply for innovation experiments — a signal that Taiwan's sandbox regime can translate pilots into permanent market offerings.

items.title_zh: 利變保單宣告利率≠定存 金管會強制雙情境試算並納內控 2027年上路
items.title_en: FSC mandates dual-scenario illustrations for interest-sensitive insurance policies from 2027
items.summary_zh: 為遏止民眾把利變型保單的宣告利率誤當銀行定存利率，金管會修正「人身保險業辦理利率變動型保險商品業務應注意事項」，定於2027年1月1日生效。新制要求保險業者提供強制雙情境試算，呈現宣告利率維持與調降兩種情境下的保單利益，並將相關揭露程序納入內部控制制度。利變保單是銀行保險通路主力商品，長期存在以宣告利率類比定存的銷售爭議，惟宣告利率並非保證、可能調降。新規將提高銷售文件與適合度要求，對以高宣告利率為訴求的行銷模式形成約束；對保戶而言可更清楚掌握報酬變動風險。保險業者須在2026年底前完成系統、文宣與教育訓練調整。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's FSC amended the rules governing interest-sensitive insurance products, effective January 1, 2027, to stop consumers from mistaking declared crediting rates for bank deposit rates. Insurers must provide mandatory dual-scenario illustrations — showing outcomes under both current and less favorable declared rates — and bring the disclosure process into their internal-control systems. The change responds to years of complaints that interest-sensitive policies, a mainstay of bancassurance sales, were pitched as deposit-like products even though declared rates are not guaranteed and can be cut. For wealth managers and bank sales channels, the rule raises documentation and suitability requirements and could temper sales tactics built on headline crediting rates; for policyholders, it means clearer expectations about how returns can vary. Insurers have until end-2026 to adjust systems, sales materials and training.

items.title_zh: 不畏震盪現金為王 高息ETF成資金避風港 三檔獲公股掃貨逾萬張
items.title_en: High-dividend ETFs become cash havens as state-linked funds scoop up over 10,000 lots each in three funds
items.summary_zh: 台股14日遭外部利空襲擊，盤中一度重挫逾1,700點，終場跌幅收斂至642點、收44,737.95點，留下長達1,083點的下影線，顯示低檔承接買盤強勁。面對高檔震盪與地緣政治風險，市場共識轉向「現金為王」，高息ETF成為資金避風港，其中三檔最受公股青睞、各遭掃貨逾萬張。此輪資金輪動顯示，在美伊衝突與外資大幅賣超之際，內資偏好以股息緩衝波動，屬於典型防禦性配置，對高股息策略形成支撐。後續觀察台積電法說會與台指期結算後，防禦資金是否持續流入，或隨行情回穩轉回成長型標的。
items.summary_en: As Taiwan stocks plunged more than 1,700 points intraday before closing down 642 at 44,737.95, market consensus shifted toward "cash is king" — and high-dividend ETFs emerged as the preferred shelter. Three high-dividend ETFs were each bought to the tune of more than 10,000 lots by state-linked (public bank) funds, according to exchange data, while the index left a 1,083-point lower shadow showing aggressive bargain-hunting. The rotation matters for asset allocators: amid geopolitical risk from the US-Iran conflict and heavy foreign selling, domestic money is favoring yield buffers over growth beta, a defensive stance that historically supports dividend strategies during volatility spikes. Watch whether the flows persist once the TSMC earnings call and futures settlement pass, or reverse into growth names if the market stabilizes.

items.title_zh: 摩根：美國經濟可望軟著陸 Fed今年按兵不動 投資人要有心理準備
items.title_en: J.P. Morgan Asset Management: Fed likely on hold all year — investors should prepare for no cuts
items.summary_zh: 摩根資產管理亞太區首席市場策略師許長泰14日於第三季投資展望指出，全球經濟成功應對地緣政治衝擊、具備一定韌性，美國可望軟著陸，但在勞動市場與物價僵固下，市場對Fed的降息預期正在修正，預估今年利率按兵不動，投資人須對「不降息」有心理準備。環球市場策略師林雅慧則指出，美股本益比約20.3倍、接近歷史區間上緣，隨AI投資從晶片轉向電力與基礎建設，亞洲市場將受惠「AI製造紅利」，其中台股比韓股更具優勢。整體配置建議分散布局，不宜過度集中於評價偏高的美國大型股，後續觀察Fed政策路徑與AI資本支出動向。
items.summary_en: J.P. Morgan Asset Management's Asia-Pacific chief market strategist Tai Hui said at the firm's third-quarter outlook that market expectations for Federal Reserve rate cuts are being revised away. While the global economy has weathered geopolitical shocks with resilience and the US looks headed for a soft landing, labor-market dynamics and sticky prices mean the Fed is likely to keep rates unchanged this year — so investors should brace for an extended hold rather than easing. Separately, global market strategist Agnes Lin noted US equities trade at about 20.3 times earnings, near the top of their historical range, and argued Asia — Taiwan in particular — stands to benefit more than Korea from the "AI manufacturing dividend" as AI investment shifts from chips toward power and infrastructure. The house view favors diversifying beyond richly valued US large caps.

items.title_zh: 貝萊德：升息門檻極高、今年利率不變 「會賺錢」是AI硬道理
items.title_en: BlackRock mid-year outlook: rate-hike bar is high, no cuts this year, position for a new macro regime
items.summary_zh: 全球最大資產管理公司貝萊德14日舉行年中投資展望，經濟學家蔣天嬌表示，儘管市場仍存在升息預期，但目前加息門檻極高，預期今年政策利率維持不變；通膨處於下行通道，惟受服務業通膨黏性支撐，降息同樣不易。貝萊德提出「新宏觀格局」觀點，認為市場已進入高波動、高通膨時代，投資人應靈活配置以應對快速變動的環境。針對進入第四年的AI行情，貝萊德強調「會賺錢」是硬道理，隨主題成熟，資金應轉向具實質AI獲利貢獻的產業，而非僅有基礎建設題材。此觀點攸關下半年股票、信用債與另類資產的配置方向，後續觀察企業財報能否驗證AI獲利。
items.summary_en: BlackRock economist Tianjiao Jiang said at the firm's mid-year investment outlook that although markets still price some probability of tightening, the threshold for additional rate hikes is extremely high, and BlackRock expects policy rates to stay unchanged this year. Inflation is in a downward channel but service-sector stickiness limits how fast it can fall, keeping cuts off the table too. The firm frames markets as having entered a "new macro regime" of higher volatility and higher inflation, arguing investors need flexible allocation rather than static benchmarks. On AI — now in its fourth year — BlackRock stressed that "making money is the hard truth": as the theme matures, capital should rotate toward businesses with demonstrable AI-driven earnings rather than pure infrastructure stories. The view matters for portfolio construction across equities, credit and alternatives heading into the second half.

items.title_zh: 114年度綜所稅第1批退稅7月31日入帳 退稅憑單9月30日前有效
items.title_en: First batch of 2025 income-tax refunds arrives July 31
items.summary_zh: 財政部宣布，114年度綜合所得稅第1批退稅將於115年7月31日撥入指定帳戶或寄發退稅憑單。適用對象包括：6月1日前採網路或手機申報者、稅額試算以線上登錄或電話語音確認回復者，以及5月11日前以紙本向國稅局回復者。申報時提供金融機構帳號者退稅款直接入帳；未提供者由國稅局寄發憑單，兌領期限自7月31日至9月30日止，金額未滿5,000元可向指定銀行兌領現金。納稅人可至國稅局網站查詢退稅撥付狀態。財政部並提醒防範退稅詐騙，接獲可疑通知勿點閱不明連結、勿輸入個人資料，如有疑問可撥0800-000-321查證。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's Ministry of Finance announced that the first batch of individual income tax refunds for the 2025 tax year will be paid on July 31, 2026, either deposited directly into taxpayers' designated bank accounts or issued as refund vouchers. Eligible taxpayers include those who filed online or by mobile phone before June 1, those who confirmed pre-calculated tax assessments online or by phone, and those who replied to the tax bureau on paper before May 11. Taxpayers who provided bank account details get direct deposits; others receive vouchers valid from July 31 through September 30, with amounts under NT$5,000 redeemable for cash at designated banks. Refund status can be checked on the National Taxation Bureau website. The ministry also warned against refund-scam messages: do not click suspicious links or enter personal data, and call 0800-000-321 with questions.

items.title_zh: 賦稅署首長異動 宋秀玲7月16日退休 樓美鐘陞任署長
items.title_en: Taxation Administration leadership change: Sung Hsiu-ling retires, Lou Mei-chung promoted
items.summary_zh: 財政部14日發布賦稅署首長人事案：賦稅署署長宋秀玲於115年7月16日退休，遺缺由臺北國稅局局長樓美鐘陞任。賦稅署是財政部核心稅政單位，主掌所得稅、遺產及贈與稅、房地合一稅、最低稅負制等法規之研擬與解釋，署長人事攸關信託課稅實務、CFC制度執行、不動產稅制查核等待決議題的推進方向。由資深國稅局首長內升，顯示稅政方向以延續為主，短期內政策大幅轉向機率低。稅務從業人員與高資產族群可留意新任署長上任後的查核重點與解釋函令動向，作為稅務規劃與申報遵循的參考。
items.summary_en: The Ministry of Finance announced a leadership change at its Taxation Administration: Director-General Sung Hsiu-ling will retire on July 16, 2026, and Lou Mei-chung, currently head of the National Taxation Bureau of Taipei, will be promoted to succeed her. The Taxation Administration is the ministry's core tax-policy unit, responsible for drafting and interpreting rules across income tax, estate and gift tax, house-and-land transactions tax, the alternative minimum tax and related regimes. Leadership continuity matters to taxpayers and advisers because the director-general shapes the agenda on pending issues — from trust taxation practice and CFC administration to real-estate tax enforcement — and the elevation of a senior tax-bureau veteran signals administrative continuity rather than a policy shift. Practitioners will watch early signals on audit priorities and interpretive rulings under the new director-general.

items.title_zh: 輸美貨品原產地聲明書線上作業上線 7月1日起全程數位化
items.title_en: Online filing for US-bound origin declarations goes live
items.summary_zh: 財政部14日宣布，自115年7月1日起，出口人可使用工商憑證或自然人憑證，透過關港貿單一窗口線上填報、簽署、產製並提交輸美國貨品原產地聲明書，取代原有紙本作業。在美國關稅制度下，原產地文件已成為關鍵合規項目，正確且可驗證的原產地聲明攸關關稅待遇認定，並可避免出口貨物在美國通關時遭罰款或延誤。對台灣電子、機械等出口製造業而言，線上化作業可縮短處理時間、降低錯誤率，並留存可稽核軌跡。財政部呼籲出口人多加利用，以加速通關並強化原產地管理遵循，因應美國貿易執法趨嚴的環境。
items.summary_en: The Ministry of Finance announced that exporters can now complete origin declarations for goods bound for the United States entirely online. Since July 1, exporters have been able to fill in, sign, generate and submit US-bound goods origin declarations through the Customs-Port-Trade single window using industrial/commercial certificates or citizen digital certificates, replacing paper-based processing. The digitization matters because origin documentation has become a critical compliance item under the US tariff regime: accurate, verifiable origin declarations determine duty treatment and help exporters avoid penalties or shipment delays at US customs. For Taiwan's export-heavy manufacturers — from electronics to machinery — the online workflow cuts processing time and error rates, and provides an auditable trail. The ministry encouraged exporters to adopt the online service to speed clearance and strengthen origin-management compliance as US trade enforcement intensifies.

items.title_zh: 新台幣量縮微貶收32.172元 外資匯出、央行尾盤調節
items.title_en: Taiwan dollar slips slightly to 32.172 as central bank smooths late-session swings
items.summary_zh: 台股14日一度急殺逾1,700點，外資積極賣股匯出，新台幣兌美元盤中最低下探32.229元；所幸出口商逢低進場拋匯意願升高，加上央行尾盤調節，貶勢收斂，終場收在32.172元、微貶0.2分，成交量縮。市場並觀望美國6月CPI數據，該數據將牽動Fed利率預期與美元走勢。新台幣匯率攸關出口商獲利、輸入性通膨與外資持有台灣資產的總報酬，在美伊衝突升溫、外資連日賣超的環境下，後續觀察外資匯出是否持續、央行調節力道，以及美國通膨數據公布後美元指數的方向。
items.summary_en: The New Taiwan dollar weakened marginally against the US dollar on Monday, closing down 0.2 cents at 32.172 on subdued volume. Foreign investors selling Taiwan stocks and remitting proceeds abroad pushed the currency as low as 32.229 intraday — pressure amplified by the stock market's 1,700-point plunge. But exporters stepped up dollar selling at the lows and the central bank smoothed the market in the late session, narrowing the decline. Traders were also in wait-and-see mode ahead of the US June CPI release, which would shape Federal Reserve rate expectations and, by extension, dollar strength. The currency matters for exporters' margins, imported-inflation pass-through and foreign investors' total returns on Taiwan assets; watch whether foreign equity outflows persist and how the central bank manages volatility if geopolitical risk stays elevated.

items.title_zh: 富人也有感 高所得家庭6月CPI年增2.83% 娛樂、雜項漲最多
items.title_en: High-income households feel it too: their June CPI rose 2.83%, led by recreation and miscellaneous costs
items.summary_zh: 最新物價統計顯示，通膨壓力連高所得家庭也難倖免：6月高所得家庭CPI年增率達2.83%，其中以娛樂與雜項類漲幅最大。數據凸顯服務類通膨——旅遊、外食、娛樂與個人服務——已成物價上漲主要動力，在商品價格趨穩之際，反而對消費力較強的族群衝擊更明顯。對政策面而言，服務通膨黏性增加央行穩定通膨預期的難度；對財富管理而言，高資產客戶的消費籃偏向服務類，更需要納入抗通膨配置思維，如實質資產、股息成長型標的等。後續觀察下半年基期效應淡化後服務類漲勢是否降溫，以及央行理監事會對需求面壓力的評估。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's June consumer price data show inflation is squeezing affluent households as well: the CPI for high-income families rose 2.83% year-on-year, with recreation and miscellaneous categories posting the largest increases. The figures underline that services inflation — travel, dining, entertainment and personal services — is now the main driver of price pressure, hitting discretionary spenders hardest even as goods prices stabilize. For policymakers, sticky services inflation complicates the central bank's job of anchoring expectations; for wealth managers, it strengthens the case for inflation-aware portfolio construction — real assets, dividend growth and inflation-linked exposure — among high-net-worth clients whose consumption baskets skew toward services. Watch whether services momentum cools in the second half as base effects fade and whether the central bank flags demand-side pressure in its next policy meeting.

items.title_zh: 北市颱風假股市正常交易？卓榮泰鬆口：可研議
items.title_en: Premier open to studying normal stock trading on typhoon days
items.summary_zh: 行政院長卓榮泰14日表示，台北市放颱風假時股市是否照常交易「可研議」，為制度調整開啟討論空間。依現行做法，北部縣市宣布停班停課時，股匯市同步休市；但在交易全面電子化、國際市場持續運作下，休市安排屢被批評不合時宜。本月巴威颱風襲台期間股市停擺，投資人無法即時因應國際行情波動，外資也面臨避險與交割作業的困擾。若要改為照常交易，須由金管會、交易所與結算機構就人力配置、防災安全與交割規則協調配套。此議題攸關台灣打造亞洲資產管理中心的目標——交易連續性與國際接軌程度是重要信任指標，後續觀察主管機關研議進度。
items.summary_en: Premier Cho Jung-tai signaled openness to reviewing whether Taiwan's stock market should keep trading when Taipei declares a typhoon day, saying the idea "can be studied." Currently, when northern Taiwan announces work and school suspensions, the stock and FX markets close — an arrangement critics call outdated now that brokers, exchanges and investors operate electronically and global markets keep moving. Recent typhoons, including this month's Typhoon Bavi, halted trading and left Taiwanese investors unable to react to international volatility, raising hedging risks and settlement complications for foreign institutions. Any change would require coordination among the FSC, the exchanges and clearing systems on staffing, disaster safety and settlement rules. The debate matters for Taiwan's ambitions as an Asian asset-management hub, where trading continuity and alignment with international practice are key credibility tests.

items.title_zh: 美股收盤漲跌互見 CPI降溫助攻 IBM暴跌25%創紀錄
items.title_en: US stocks close mixed as cooler CPI offsets IBM's record 25% crash
items.summary_zh: 美股14日收盤漲跌互見。美國6月通膨數據低於市場預期，緩解Fed進一步升息的憂慮，標普500上漲0.38%收7,543.59點，那斯達克在半導體股帶動下上漲0.9%收26,107.01點，道瓊受IBM重挫拖累僅小漲9.63點收52,508.27點。IBM因發布獲利預警暴跌逾25%，創至少1968年以來最大單日跌幅，市值蒸發近690億美元。川普另撤回對荷姆茲海峽收取20%過路費的構想，稍解油價疑慮，惟美軍同步恢復對伊朗海上封鎖。此役重設市場對Fed政策的預期，牽動台股今日開盤氣氛與台積電法說會前的資金布局。
items.summary_en: US equities ended mixed on Tuesday after June inflation came in below expectations, easing fears of further Federal Reserve tightening. The S&P 500 rose 0.38% to 7,543.59 and the Nasdaq advanced 0.9% to 26,107.01, powered by semiconductor stocks, while the Dow closed nearly flat at 52,508.27 as IBM's collapse weighed. IBM plunged more than 25% after a profit warning — its worst single-day drop since at least 1968 — erasing close to US$69 billion of market value. President Trump also withdrew his proposal for a 20% transit fee on the Strait of Hormuz, tempering one source of oil-price anxiety even as the US reinstated its naval blockade of Iran. The session matters for Asian investors as it resets Fed expectations ahead of Taiwan's trading day and the TSMC earnings call.

items.title_zh: SK海力士ADR暴漲27% 巴克萊喊買 目標價上看330美元
items.title_en: SK Hynix ADR surges 27% as Barclays initiates with overweight and a $330 target
items.summary_zh: SK海力士ADR在巴克萊首次給予「增持」評級後一度大漲27%，不僅收復前一交易日跌幅，也使ADR相對首爾掛牌股票的溢價擴大至46%。巴克萊看好HBM（高頻寬記憶體）供應在AI需求強勁下持續吃緊，將目標價上調至330美元，以其估算仍有逾一倍上漲空間。此波劇烈走勢顯示AI記憶體缺貨題材正吸引動能資金湧入新掛牌ADR，跨市場價差擴大且套利不易收斂。對台灣記憶體與封測供應鏈而言，HBM價格堅挺有利獲利展望，但過高溢價也反映投機情緒，若AI資本支出訊號轉弱恐急遽回吐，後續觀察韓股本尊與ADR價差收斂情形。
items.summary_en: SK Hynix's American depositary receipts jumped as much as 27% after Barclays initiated coverage with an overweight rating, not only recouping the prior session's losses but pushing the ADR premium over the Seoul-listed shares to 46%. Barclays argues high-bandwidth memory supply will stay tight as AI demand runs hot, setting a US$330 price target that implies more than 100% further upside by its math. The violent move matters beyond one stock: it shows how AI-memory scarcity is driving momentum flows into newly listed ADRs, widening cross-market price gaps that arbitrageurs cannot easily close. For Taiwan's memory and packaging supply chain, firm HBM pricing supports the earnings outlook, but the extreme premium also flags speculative froth that could unwind sharply if AI capex signals soften.

items.title_zh: 美官員：僅「非常少量」輝達H200已出口中國 採逐案審查許可
items.title_en: US official: only "very small" volume of Nvidia H200 chips exported to China under case-by-case licenses
items.summary_zh: 美國商務部高層官員證實，輝達H200 AI晶片已開始出口至中國，但整體出貨規模仍非常有限，且每筆出口均採逐案審查核發許可。此番說法釐清華府部分鬆綁的實際範圍：並非全面重啟中國市場，而是緩步放行、保留對先進運算出口的談判籌碼。中國市場曾是輝達與其台灣製造夥伴的重要營收來源，少量許可出貨有助市場情緒，但對出貨量預估影響有限。後續觀察許可核發是否加速、中國買家在國產晶片替代壓力下的採購意願，以及美國國會對擴大出口的政治反應，均牽動AI供應鏈的中國業務展望。
items.summary_en: A senior US Commerce Department official confirmed that Nvidia's H200 artificial-intelligence chips have begun shipping to China, but stressed the volumes are still very limited and each export is being approved through case-by-case license reviews. The comments clarify the practical scope of Washington's partial easing: rather than reopening the China market broadly, the administration is meting out approvals slowly, keeping leverage over advanced-computing flows. The disclosure matters for the AI supply chain because China demand was once a meaningful revenue pool for Nvidia and its Taiwanese manufacturing partners; a trickle of licensed H200 shipments supports sentiment without materially changing volume forecasts. Investors will watch whether license approvals accelerate, how Chinese buyers respond given domestic-chip substitution pressure, and whether Congress pushes back on any expansion of permitted sales.

items.title_zh: 真人般的AI夥伴 OpenAI首款硬體裝置傳為無螢幕智慧音箱
items.title_en: OpenAI's first hardware device reportedly a screenless smart speaker
items.summary_zh: 據《彭博》14日報導，OpenAI將推出一款可攜式、無螢幕的智慧音箱，作為首款消費性硬體產品，正式從軟體跨入裝置領域。該產品源於OpenAI與前蘋果設計長Jony Ive團隊的合作，主打對話優先的AI夥伴體驗，而非再造一塊螢幕。就在幾天前，蘋果才以竊取商業機密為由，對OpenAI及兩名前蘋果員工提起訴訟，凸顯AI硬體競賽的煙硝味。若AI原生裝置成為新品類，可望為以台廠為主的消費電子供應鏈帶來組裝、聲學與晶片新訂單；同時也對亞馬遜、Google與蘋果的語音助理生態形成世代性挑戰，後續觀察產品規格、供應鏈定點與上市時程。
items.summary_en: OpenAI plans to launch a portable, screenless smart speaker as its first consumer hardware product, Bloomberg reported Tuesday, marking the AI company's long-awaited move from software into devices. The project stems from OpenAI's collaboration with former Apple design chief Jony Ive's team and aims to create an ambient, conversation-first AI companion rather than another screen. The report lands just days after Apple sued OpenAI and two former Apple employees, alleging theft of trade secrets — a sign of how contentious the AI-hardware race is becoming. The move matters for the consumer-electronics supply chain, much of it Taiwanese, as a hit AI-native device category could open new assembly, acoustics and silicon orders; it also pressures Amazon, Google and Apple, whose voice assistants now face a generational challenge from LLM-powered rivals.

items.title_zh: 美國重啟封鎖伊朗 油價飆漲約2%創近一個月新高
items.title_en: Oil jumps about 2% to one-month high as US reinstates Iran blockade
items.summary_zh: 美國重新對伊朗港口及沿海地區實施海上封鎖，加上中東衝突持續升溫，引發市場對荷姆茲海峽原油運輸受阻的憂慮，國際油價14日大漲約2%創近一個月新高，布蘭特原油收在每桶84.73美元附近、WTI約79.34美元。美軍同步對伊朗目標發動新一輪空襲，荷姆茲海峽油輪通行量下滑，地緣政治風險溢價快速回升。全球約五分之一的原油供應行經荷姆茲海峽，若運輸持續受阻，將迅速推升燃料成本與整體通膨，恰逢美國物價壓力才剛出現降溫跡象，時點敏感。後續觀察美國原油庫存數據與衝突是否升級為更大規模航運攻擊。
items.summary_en: Crude oil rallied about 2% on Tuesday to its highest in roughly a month after the United States reinstated its naval blockade of Iranian ports and coastal areas, reviving fears that crude flows through the Strait of Hormuz could be disrupted. Brent settled around US$84.73 a barrel and WTI near US$79.34, with the geopolitical premium rebuilding as the US also launched fresh airstrikes on Iranian targets and tanker transits through Hormuz fell. Roughly a fifth of global oil supply moves through the strait, so any sustained disruption would feed quickly into fuel costs and headline inflation — an uncomfortable prospect just as US price pressure showed signs of cooling. Markets will watch US crude inventory data and whether the conflict escalates toward broader shipping attacks, which would force fresh repricing of both energy and rate expectations.

items.title_zh: 美國6月CPI月減0.4%創2020年4月以來最大降幅
items.title_en: US inflation cools sharply: June CPI falls 0.4%, the biggest monthly drop since April 2020
items.summary_zh: 美國6月CPI經季調後月減0.4%，年增率降至3.5%、低於預期的3.8%（5月為4.2%）；核心CPI月比持平、年增2.6%。數據公布後，期貨市場對Fed 7月升息機率的定價由42%驟降至約17%，9月仍有約六成升息機率。
items.summary_en: The consumer price index fell a seasonally adjusted 0.4% in June, bringing annual inflation down to 3.5% versus 3.8% expected, after 4.2% in May. Core CPI was flat on the month, putting the 12-month core rate at 2.6%. Futures-implied odds of a July Fed rate hike dropped to about 17% from 42%.

items.title_zh: IBM暴跌25%創史上最慘單日 獲利預警嚇壞市場
items.title_en: IBM craters 25% in its worst day on record after second-quarter earnings warning
items.summary_zh: IBM公布初步財報，調整後EPS 2.93美元、營收172億美元，均低於市場預期，執行長Krishna歸因於客戶IT預算轉向AI硬體。股價重挫25.2%收217.07美元，跌幅超越1987年黑色星期一的23.7%，市值單日蒸發約670億美元。
items.summary_en: IBM shares sank 25% to $217.07 after preliminary results showed adjusted EPS of $2.93 on revenue of $17.2 billion, missing estimates of $3.01 and $17.86 billion. CEO Arvind Krishna blamed clients shifting IT budgets from software and infrastructure toward AI hardware. The drop exceeded IBM's 23.7% Black Monday fall in 1987 and wiped out roughly $67 billion of market value.

items.title_zh: 摩根大通單季獲利169億美元創紀錄 股票交易收入暴增86%
items.title_en: JPMorgan notches record $16.9 billion profit on $6 billion stock-trading haul
items.summary_zh: 摩根大通第二季獲利169億美元、EPS 6.14美元，優於預期的5.59美元；受惠戰事引發的市場波動，股票交易收入年增86%至60.3億美元，整體交易收入121億美元創歷史新高，營收580億美元亦超出預期。
items.summary_en: JPMorgan Chase reported record second-quarter profit of $16.9 billion, or $6.14 a share, beating estimates of $5.59, as equities trading revenue surged 86% year-on-year to $6.03 billion amid war-driven volatility. Total trading revenue hit an all-time high of $12.1 billion and managed revenue reached $58 billion.

items.title_zh: Fed主席華許：對高通膨「零容忍」 拒絕預告7月決策
items.title_en: Fed Chair Warsh says central bank has "no tolerance" for elevated inflation
items.summary_zh: 新任Fed主席華許首度赴國會作證，向眾院金融服務委員會表示決策官員對持續偏高的通膨「零容忍」，但未透露7月會議動向。他稱6月CPI降溫僅是單月數據、「不代表大功告成」；利率決策委員會內部對今年是否需再升息看法約各半。
items.summary_en: In his first congressional testimony since becoming Fed chair on May 22, Kevin Warsh told the House Financial Services Committee that policymakers have "no tolerance for persistently elevated inflation," while declining to signal the July rate decision. He called June's soft CPI just one month of data — "not mission accomplished" — with the rate-setting committee roughly split on whether hikes are needed this year.

items.title_zh: 美對伊朗新一輪空襲、油價創四週新高 川普放棄荷姆茲收費
items.title_en: Oil rises to four-week highs as US launches new Iran airstrikes and drops Hormuz fee plan
items.summary_zh: 美國恢復對伊朗海上封鎖並發動新空襲，WTI漲1.5%收79.34美元、布蘭特漲1.72%收84.73美元，創約一個月新高。兩艘阿聯油輪在荷姆茲海峽遭伊朗巡弋飛彈擊中、一名船員罹難；川普則撤回收取20%海峽過路費的構想，海峽油輪通行量降至兩個月低點。
items.summary_en: WTI rose 1.5% to settle at $79.34 and Brent gained 1.72% to $84.73, the highest in about a month, as the US reinstated its naval blockade of Iran and launched fresh airstrikes. Two UAE tankers were hit by Iranian cruise missiles in the Strait of Hormuz, killing one crew member, while President Trump abandoned his proposed 20% strait transit fee. Hormuz tanker transits fell to a two-month low.

items.title_zh: Uber深入洽談收購Delivery Hero 最快本週達成協議
items.title_en: Uber in advanced talks to acquire Germany's Delivery Hero, deal could come this week
items.summary_zh: 據《彭博》報導，Uber正就收購德國外送平台Delivery Hero進行深入談判，最快本週達成協議；交易估值可望明顯高於近期約36歐元的股價（5月首次提案為每股33歐元、約100億歐元），Uber並已將持股自25%提高至近37%。消息後Delivery Hero股價漲近6%，Uber跌約2%。
items.summary_en: Uber is in advanced negotiations to take over Delivery Hero and aims for an agreement as soon as this week, Bloomberg reported. A deal would likely value the German food-delivery firm well above its recent ~€36 share price; Uber's initial May proposal of €33 a share implied about €10 billion. Uber has lifted its stake to nearly 37% from 25%. Delivery Hero shares rose almost 6%; Uber fell about 2%.
